content: Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«'Ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ ketiniwarutahɨawi meke'ukunuaxɨani Pi-'Akiruti hɨxie mekekuyaxe, Mikiruri meta haramara wahixɨapa. Haramara tetsita mekekuyaxe, Wahari-Tsepuni hɨxie.
Parahuni mɨpaɨ pɨti'erieni: “'Ixaheritsixi mekaneuyexɨrieni mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie. Makumawe kaniwakunaka”.

Ne, nepipitɨani 'iyarieya tse'ime Parahuni, mɨxe'anukuweiyakɨ. Peru ne mariweme nepaneyeitɨani Parahuni hɨxie meta kuyaximama wahɨxie. 'Ana 'ekipitutari mɨpaɨ mepɨtehetimani kename ne Yawé nehɨkɨ». Hikɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniuyɨni 'ixaheritsixi.

Kepauka 'Ekipitu ti'aitame mɨretima, kename teɨteri mehekɨnekai, hikɨ mɨkɨ meta te'i'uximayatametemama mepuyupataxɨ, mɨpaɨ meputiyua 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme: «Neuxei ketete'uyuri. ¿Titayari tetewarupitɨa 'ixaheritsixi memɨyehukɨ meta yu'uximayatsika memuku'eirienikɨ?»
Merikɨte 'ana kwitɨwa Parahuni katiniuta'aita kaxetaya mukuha'aritsienikɨ meta kuyaximama memuyukuha'aritɨanikɨ,
kaniwaruta'inieni 'ataxewime tsienituyari kaxetate 'aixɨa mɨ'anene, meta hipame kaxetate 'Ekipitu mieme, xexuitɨ kaxetatetsie kuyaxi mekanati'utɨkateitɨni.
Yawé Parahuni 'iyarieya kaniutseiriya 'Ekipitu ti'aitame, para 'ixaheritsixi mɨwaranukuweiyakɨ, mɨkɨ mekaniuhukaitɨni mete'ayu'iwake meyu'erietɨ.

Yunaitɨ Parahuni kuyaximama mekaniwaranukuweiya, kawayutsixi wahetsie me'utetɨ, kaxetate kuyaxa miemete mewaruhapatɨ, hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi mekaniwaranuku'axe haramara tetsita paitɨ mekaniwarutaxeiya, hehurakaku Pi-'Akiruti meta Wahari-Tsepuni hɨxie.
Parahuni kanaye'aximekaitɨni. Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi memɨyu'ɨwiyaxɨ 'ekipitutari mepɨwaruxei 'ari hura me'ahukame, hikɨ waɨkawa mekaniutimamani, Yawé mekaniutahɨawe.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ Muitsexi mekateniutatieni: —Kamɨtsɨ karexɨawekai 'Ekipitu kwie temekateukienikɨ, ¿titayari petareyewitɨ 'enapaitɨ makumawetsie temɨkwinikɨ? ¿Kehapaɨtɨtɨ pepɨtatsiyuriene?
Yatepaitɨkatei 'Ekipitu paitɨ: “Ketaneuhayewa. Pɨtatsinake 'ekipitutari temɨtewa'uximayatsirieka”. Matsi 'aixɨa pɨ'anekai temɨteware'uximayatsiriekakɨ, 'ena temɨkakwinikɨ makumawetsie.

Muitsexi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Xepɨkaheumamaka. Xeme kayuwatɨ xeketeneteni, hikɨ kwitɨwa xemunenierixɨ xepɨhɨkɨtɨni, Yawé wikweitsitɨarika kemɨrexeiya xehetsiemieme. Hikɨ mɨkɨ 'ekipitutari xemɨwaxeiya hatsuakuri tawarita xepɨkawaxeiya.
Xeme kayuwatɨ xekeneumaka, Yawé pɨta puyutamieni xehetsiemieme.
Peru Yawé mɨpaɨ Muitsexi katiniutahɨawe: «¿Ketitayari ne penerahɨawe? 'Ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ ketiniwarutahɨawi memayekɨnekɨ.
'Ekɨta 'a'itsɨ keneutatsera haramara heima, haa kananutayepierimɨkɨ mana memukɨnekɨ 'ixaheritsixi 'ayewakikaku.
Ne 'ekipitutari wa'iyari nepɨtseiriya para memɨxe'anukuweiyakɨ. Ne mariweme nepɨtiyurieni. Parahuni kuyaximama, kaxetate meta teɨterimama memutei nepɨwareuyehɨani.
Kepauka mɨpaɨ nemɨtiyurieni, 'ana 'ekipitutari mɨpaɨ mepɨtehetimani kename ne Yawé nehɨkɨ».
Hikɨ niuki tuayame Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme 'ixaheritsixi wahɨxie mumiekai, ta'aurie kanaweni wa'utɨma pɨta kaniyuhayewa. Yaxeikɨata kaniuyɨni hai 'amuwekai wa'utɨma pɨta kaniutakeni,

'ekipitutari wahɨxie tai puke 'ixaheritsixi wahekɨariwiyatɨ. Mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie mɨkɨ hai hipame wahetsiemieme pɨyɨriyatɨkai hipame wahetsiemiemeta pɨhekɨariyatɨkai, 'ayumieme mɨpaɨ ti'anekaku mepɨkayɨwawekai memuyuxeiyanikɨ.

Hikɨ Muitsexi yu'itsɨ kaneutatsera haramara heima, Yawé 'eka kaneyenɨ'ani mɨkɨ tɨkarikɨ tau manatineika mieme karima kaniu'ekakaitɨni 'anari haramara kananutayepiere, ya'atayeutɨ heutanetɨ kanayewani, kwie wakitɨ kanahekɨare. Haa haramara kananutayepiere,
'ixaheritsixi mana mekaniukɨne kwie wakimetsie me'uhutɨ. Haramara kaniti'ukaitɨni 'ixumeri hepaɨ watserieta meta wa'utata.
Hikɨ 'ekipitutari mekaniwaranukuweiya. Yunaitɨ memutekai kawayutsixi wahetsie meta kaxetatetsie, yunaitɨ Parahuni hetsɨamiemete mekanekɨneta wa'utɨma.
Merikɨte kepauka mɨkahekɨarirɨmekairi, Yawé kaniwaruxeiya kuyaxi 'ekipitutari, tai haikɨriyaritsie paitɨ meta haiwitɨritsie paitɨ, hikɨ 'ana mɨkɨ 'axapɨwaruyuri:

mɨpaɨ katiniuyurieni, wakaxetate pukahapawakai mɨpaɨ tiuyurieku 'uxi mepɨyɨakai mepɨka'ayekɨniwawekai. Hikɨ 'ayumieme mɨpaɨ 'ekipitutari mekateniutihiwatɨkɨne: «Tepɨwahayewa 'ixaheritsixi, Yawé puyumiene wahetsiemieme, pɨtatsikwine».
Hikɨ Yawé mɨpaɨ Muitsexi katiniutahɨawe: «'Amamá keneutatsera haramara heima, para haa mɨwareuyehɨanikɨ 'ekipitutari meta wakaxetate metatsierie teɨteri memutei».

Merikɨte Muitsexi yu'itsɨ kaneutatsera haa heima, 'ari katarirɨmekaku, hikɨ haramara 'aixɨa kaniuyɨni matɨari hepaɨ. 'Ekipitutari me'uyuta'unaku yu'utɨma haa puwaranukunakixɨ, mɨpaɨ Yawé pɨtiwareuyehɨa haramara tetɨata.
Haramara heitserie 'anuyemareku, kaniwarukayunitɨani kaxetate meta teɨteri memutei Parahuni hetsɨa miemete, meta yunaitɨ kemɨ'ane 'ixaheritsixi memɨwaranukuweiyakai. Mɨkɨ nixewitɨ pɨka'utawikwei.
Peru 'ixaheritsixi teɨteriyari mekananukɨne kwie wakimetsie haramaratsietɨtɨ, mɨkɨ wahetsiemieme haa 'ixumeriyari kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni watserieta meta wa'utata.
Mɨkɨ tukaritsie Yawé mɨpaɨ katiniwaruwikweitsitɨani 'ixaheritsixi 'ekipitutari mewakwikukaku. 'Ixaheritsixi 'ekipitutari wakaxarite mekaniuxeiya haramara tetsitapaitɨ metiheikame.
Mɨya mete'uneniereka 'ixaheritsixi, yutɨrɨkariyakɨ kemɨtiuyuri 'ekipitutari wahetsie, mɨkɨ mekaniutimamani Yawé yuri mekateniuta'eririeni, yaxeikɨata Muitsexi 'iparewiwameya.
